scope: activity coordination core: contract, machine store (SQLite WAL), project-aggregate, reservations with fence and TTL, overlap detector, version reservation, inbox, CLI
gate: c8 per-file, lines 90 / branches 80, explicit --include: PASS

tests.network: none (fake registry injected; CLI test uses a fake npm on PATH)

corrections.F1: glob matcher is linear (segment dynamic programming, single-backtrack wildcard); pattern length and segment limits; test with 50 repeated **/ finishes under 50 ms
corrections.F2: last-valid snapshot written only when enabled; removed when disabled; tests compare the directory tree before and after (API and CLI)
corrections.F3: base ref validated (no leading dash) and git diff ends with --; package name validated with the npm rules, strict semver, npm view uses -- before the package; --output= and --registry= tested. Ref validation is a stricter subset of git check-ref-format (regex), not a call to it
corrections.F4: inbox entries carry kind=coordination, schema=coordination-inbox/v1 and recipient; they have no session/agent fields, so the liveness wake reader (which requires both) does not read them; atomic tmp+rename, 0600 files, 0700 directory, lstat ignores symlinks and files over 64 KiB, atomic claim on read
corrections.F5: session/tool validated by charset, text fields stripped of control characters and truncated, paths normalised
corrections.F6_F8: paths normalised (./, //, ..; absolute and .. rejected); glob against glob overlaps conservatively by literal prefix (severity declared, never hot_file); path: reservations compare by glob overlap (acquired as advisory, conflicted=true); package names lowercased and +build dropped; contracts and @org/contracts are different npm packages and stay different keys (documented in service.js)
corrections.F7: another session's worktree is used as cwd or inbox root only when it has .git and its origin matches the recorded repo; otherwise the inbox falls back to <dirname(store.path)>/inbox
corrections.F9: store directory 0700, database and -wal/-shm 0600 regardless of umask (tested with umask 0)
corrections.F10: heartbeat updates the row, event only when a stale session resumes; sessions silent for more than reservations.ttl_s leave listActive, appear in listStale and are never deleted; migrate takes no lock when the schema is current
corrections.F11_exit_code: reserve acquired with published/tag/candidate/overlap conflict exits 3 with conflicted:true (enforce off); refused exits 2
corrections.F12: reserve sweeps overdue leases first; git diff failure and invalid base warn; --fence must be an integer; missing adapter backend warns
corrections.F14: store.project_dirs added to the contract table in .specs/features/harness-w5/coordination.md
corrections.guard_publish: guard-publish is dispatched to runGuardPublish(spec, options) through a tolerant loader; without the module: exit 2 and 'guard-publish indisponível nesta instalação'; dispatch tested with a stub (supersedes the earlier exit 1 choice)
corrections.A2: service mirrors activity_declared and reservation_conflict (and inbox notifications) synchronously to the adapters of store.adapters, each call in try/catch; the CLI loads them from tools/cli/lib/activity-adapters/<name>.js (name charset checked, no traversal); absent or failing adapters only warn
corrections.A3: guard-publish is dispatched to runGuardPublish(spec, options) through a tolerant loader; without the module: exit 2 and 'guard-publish indisponível nesta instalação'; dispatch tested with a stub (supersedes the earlier exit 1 choice)
corrections.A6: check returns foreign_reservations: active claims of OTHER sessions that overlap the declared paths (same repo) or identifiers; tested for the experimental.6 scenario from both sides
corrections.inbox_non_object: readInbox skips non-object entries with a warning without dropping the valid ones; symlinks ignored by lstat
corrections.B1: guard-publish dispatch accepts a number or {exitCode,...} and propagates it to the process (0 allow/warn/skip, 1 refuse, 2 invalid); exits 2 when the module is absent or returns no code. Tested as a real process through a wrapper that imports the command and injects the stub via the internal loaders object; the environment-variable module hook was removed
corrections.sanitisation_round_2: control (Cc, Zl, Zp) become a space; Cf (incl. U+00AD, U+180E), U+034F, variation selectors (also supplementary), U+3164, U+2800 and U+115F are dropped from free text and make a path invalid
corrections.stale_and_unknown_session: check, list(session) and overlaps notices: unknown session and stale session produce an explicit warning (deduplicated), not a silent empty result
corrections.diverging_worktree: git diff of a worktree that is missing, not a git worktree or whose origin differs from the recorded repo is ignored WITH a warning
corrections.H1: adapter loader resolves <name>-adapter.js then <name>.js inside tools/cli/lib/activity-adapters (directory injectable through cli.loaders.adapterDir), accepts createAdapter or create<Name>Adapter (createAxonAdapter) or a module that is itself the adapter; name regex and directory containment kept. Tested with a fixture that replicates the adapters track artifact (axon-adapter.js exporting createAxonAdapter) through the real loader, end to end, without stubbing the loader
corrections.M1_P6: test proves the name regex bars ../evil, .., a/b, uppercase, empty, leading dash, overlong and NUL names and that an evil.js outside the adapter directory is never loaded
corrections.sanitisation_round_3: U+FFA0, U+1160, U+17B4 and U+17B5 are dropped as well, with a test
corrections.diff_warning_once: git diff warnings (untrusted worktree, invalid base, failed diff, e.g. no origin/HEAD) are recorded as an activity_warning event with a dedupe key and emitted once per session instead of on every prompt; project-aggregate has no event store and keeps warning each time
